Install a specific version. Also enables downgrading to an older version.

## CLI flag

Use `--version` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                 | Flag                |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| [`remotion upgrade`](/docs/cli/upgrade) | `--version <value>` |
